source_boundary: identical frozen authoritative rows in freshly migrated isolated PostgreSQL schemas
timing_boundary: observed local product service/graph latency, including specialist checkpoint setup; excludes migration and source loading
safety_boundary: actual projected safety tool calls and bundled safety assessments counted separately; no hidden evidence completion
evidence_validity_boundary: evidence_valid measures admitted provenance/scope; expiry, discarded rows and completeness are reported separately

adversarial_policy_simulation.source_boundary: frozen SQLite source mirror; production SQL readers and policy/evidence contracts
adversarial_policy_simulation.timing_boundary: observed local simulation wall time; excludes PostgreSQL graph, network and live inference
adversarial_policy_simulation.safety_boundary: full private seven-tool reread on terminal proposal/blocker; counted separately
adversarial_policy_simulation.future_live: Requires separate authorization; use these source hashes, budgets and expected labels unchanged with an explicit bounded transport; retain failed/early-review runs and record actual usage/cost.
